events.POLITE_MAW.title: 礼貌的洞胃
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.INITIAL.description:
地上的大嘴铺好餐巾，把[gold]药水和金币[/gold]推到你面前，盯着你的牌组。

[green]“请问，能分我一点吃的吗？”[/green]
{IsMultiplayer:每人|}移除[blue]1[/blue]张攻击牌。获得[gold]攻击药水[/gold]。
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.INITIAL.options.ATTACK_: {IsMultiplayer:每名存活玩家都需要可移除的攻击牌。|你没有可移除的攻击牌。}
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.INITIAL.options.SKILL.d: {IsMultiplayer:每人|}移除[blue]1[/blue]张技能牌。获得[blue]{Gold}[/blue][gold]金币[/gold]。
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.INITIAL.options.SKILL_L: {IsMultiplayer:每名存活玩家都需要可移除的技能牌。|你没有可移除的技能牌。}
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.INITIAL.options.MAIN.de: 用攻击牌换药水，或用技能牌换金币。
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.INITIAL.options.SPECIAL: 用能力牌换[gold]遗物[/gold]，或喂它一张[red]诅咒[/red]。
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.MAIN.description:
洞胃用舌尖点了点菜单。

「脆一点的，配一瓶红的。软一点的，找你零钱。」

它把小碟擦了又擦，耐心地等着。
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.MAIN.options.ATTACK.des: {IsMultiplayer:各|}移除[blue]1[/blue]张攻击牌，获得[blue]1[/blue]瓶[gold]攻击药水[/gold]。
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.MAIN.options.ATTACK_LOC: {IsMultiplayer:所有存活玩家都需要可移除的攻击牌。|没有可移除的攻击牌。}
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.MAIN.options.SKILL_LOCK: {IsMultiplayer:所有存活玩家都需要可移除的技能牌。|没有可移除的技能牌。}
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.MAIN.options.BACK.title: 再看看
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.SPECIAL.description:
洞胃吐出一件[gold]遗物[/gold]，用餐巾擦了擦。

[green]“这个，换更好吃的。”[/green]

它想了想，又补了一句：[red]“苦的不行。”[/red]
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.SPECIAL.options.POWER_L: {IsMultiplayer:每名存活玩家都需要可移除的能力牌。|你没有可移除的能力牌。}
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.SPECIAL.options.CURSE.d: {IsMultiplayer:有诅咒的玩家各|}移除[blue]1[/blue]张[red]诅咒[/red]。[red]{IsMultiplayer:全队|}与洞胃战斗！[/red]
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.SPECIAL.options.CURSE_L: {IsMultiplayer:没有玩家持有可移除的诅咒。|你没有可移除的诅咒。}
events.POLITE_MAW.selection.CURSE: 选择一张诅咒移除。随后进入战斗。
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.ATTACK.description:
洞胃把牌嚼得[jitter]嘎嘣作响[/jitter]，满意地将[gold]药水[/gold]推给你。

[green]“多谢！”[/green]

你决定先擦擦瓶口。
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.SKILL.description:
牌被一口吞下。洞胃打了个嗝，一小堆[gold]金币[/gold]跟着掉了出来。

你捡起金币。它看起来也挺满意的。
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.POWER.description:
洞胃吞下牌，闭上眼睛，慢慢回味。

你拿走了[gold]{Relic}[/gold]。它已经顾不上和你道别了。
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.LEAVE.description:
你摇了摇头。洞胃失望地叹了口气，还是朝你挥了挥舌头。

[green]“慢走。”[/green]
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.ABORTED.description:
你把牌收了回去。

洞胃看看空碟，又看看你。你决定赶紧离开。
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.TIP.description:
洞胃推来几枚[gold]金币[/gold]。

[green]“谢谢你没踩到我。”[/green]

你收下了。它说得有道理。
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.INITIAL.options.POWER_L: {IsMultiplayer:每名存活玩家都需要可移除的能力牌。|你没有可移除的能力牌。}
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.INITIAL.options.CURSE.d: {IsMultiplayer:有诅咒的玩家各|}移除[blue]1[/blue]张[red]诅咒[/red]。[red]{IsMultiplayer:全队|}与洞胃战斗！[/red]
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.INITIAL.options.CURSE_L: {IsMultiplayer:没有玩家持有可移除的诅咒。|你没有可移除的诅咒。}

events.POLITE_MAW.title: Polite Maw
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.INITIAL.description:
The mouth spreads its napkin and pushes [gold]a potion and some coins[/gold] toward you, watching your deck.

[green]“Could you spare something to eat?”[/green]
{IsMultiplayer:Each player removes|Remove} [blue]1[/blue] Attack. {IsMultiplayer:Each receives|Obtain} an [gold]Attack Potion[/gold].
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.INITIAL.options.ATTACK_: {IsMultiplayer:Every living player needs a removable Attack.|You have no removable Attacks.}
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.INITIAL.options.SKILL_L: {IsMultiplayer:Every living player needs a removable Skill.|You have no removable Skills.}
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.INITIAL.options.MAIN.de: Trade an Attack for a potion, or a Skill for Gold.
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.INITIAL.options.SPECIAL: Trade a Power for a [gold]Relic[/gold], or feed it a [red]Curse[/red].
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.MAIN.description:
The maw taps the menu with the tip of its tongue.

"Something crunchy gets a bottle of red. Something soft gets change."

It polishes the little plate once more and waits.
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.MAIN.options.ATTACK.des: {IsMultiplayer:Each player removes|Remove} [blue]1[/blue] Attack and {IsMultiplayer:receives|receive} an [gold]Attack Potion[/gold].
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.MAIN.options.ATTACK_LOC: {IsMultiplayer:Every living player needs a removable Attack.|No removable Attacks.}
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.MAIN.options.SKILL_LOCK: {IsMultiplayer:Every living player needs a removable Skill.|No removable Skills.}
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.MAIN.options.BACK.title: Keep Looking
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.SPECIAL.description:
The maw spits out a [gold]Relic[/gold] and wipes it with the napkin.

[green]“This, for something tastier.”[/green]

It pauses, then adds: [red]“Nothing bitter.”[/red]
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.SPECIAL.options.POWER_L: {IsMultiplayer:Every living player needs a removable Power.|You have no removable Powers.}
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.SPECIAL.options.CURSE.d: Remove [blue]1[/blue] [red]Curse[/red]{IsMultiplayer: each, if able|}. [red]{IsMultiplayer:Everyone fights|Fight} the Maw![/red]
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.SPECIAL.options.CURSE_L: {IsMultiplayer:No player has a removable Curse.|You have no removable Curses.}
events.POLITE_MAW.selection.CURSE: Choose a Curse to remove. A fight follows.
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.ATTACK.description:
The maw [jitter]crunches[/jitter] through the card and slides you the [gold]potion[/gold].

[green]“Much obliged!”[/green]

You decide to wipe the bottle first.
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.SKILL.description:
It swallows the card in one gulp. A burp follows, along with a small pile of [gold]coins[/gold].

You pocket the money. It seems pleased with the deal, too.
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.POWER.description:
The maw swallows the card, closes its eyes, and savors it.

You take [gold]{Relic}[/gold]. It is too distracted to say goodbye.
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.LEAVE.description:
You shake your head. The maw sighs, but still waves its tongue at you.

[green]“Safe travels.”[/green]
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.ABORTED.description:
You put the card away.

The maw looks at the empty plate, then at you. You decide to leave quickly.
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.TIP.description:
The maw slides over a few [gold]coins[/gold].

[green]“Thank you for not stepping on me.”[/green]

You accept. It has a point.
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.INITIAL.options.POWER_L: {IsMultiplayer:Every living player needs a removable Power.|You have no removable Powers.}
events.POLITE_MAW.pages.INITIAL.options.CURSE.d: Remove [blue]1[/blue] [red]Curse[/red]{IsMultiplayer: each, if able|}. [red]{IsMultiplayer:Everyone fights|Fight} the Maw![/red]
